parameters.name: lead_time_L
parameters.description: Integer shipment lead time. Optimized during calibration; evaluation uses lead_time=2 for ID and 5 for OOD.

parameters.name: arrival_flag
parameters.description: Binary flag controlling pipeline arrival convention (deliver_at_remaining_1 vs deliver_at_remaining_0).

parameters.name: poisson_lambda
parameters.description: Poisson demand rate parameter; primary continuous variable for alpha embedding.

notes: Always evaluate W_in on lead_time=2 test set and W_out on lead_time=5 test_ood set using the same calibrated parameters.
